question: Construct an exact finite common-volume caloric endpoint map, residual transport, tangent and interval bounds from separately owned gas energy, particle-count and geometry-work ports.
new_contribution_relative_to_PR237: PR237 supplies a differential conditional thermal source/JVP. This unit derives finite endpoint reconstruction, source-defect sensitivity and composition across changes of reference volume. It does not recompute or replace that source.

conventions.N: Thermal translational-particle count per common initial reference volume V0; includes ions/atoms and thermal electrons once, excludes fast electrons.
conventions.U: Gas translational energy J per V0, excluding binding/excitation and radiation stores.
conventions.c: Specified positive per-particle constant heat capacity in J/K; physical monatomic choice 3*k_B/2 is conditional on matched bath EOS.
conventions.Q: Signed integrated gas event-energy port per V0, already SI.
conventions.W: Signed stored gas geometry work per V0, already integrated; no second adiabatic factor.
conventions.R: Positive Vb/V0; proper endpoint densities U/R and N/R.
conventions.temperature: T=U/(c*N). Exact rational T and positive log argument; no numerical log evaluation is required for the algebraic implementation.
conventions.count_projection: For selected H-only transaction dN=dNeutral+dIon+dThermalElectron=sum(dFine)+dContinuum; retain source baryon/count defects.
conventions.normalization: Integrated events carry no 1/H. R and positive baryon normalization cancel in temperature but remain in individual density/abundance coordinates.

theorems: Finite ideal endpoint: Nhat=Na+dN, Uhat=c*Na*Ta+Q+W, That=Uhat/(c*Nhat), requiring Na,Ta,c,Nhat,Uhat positive.
Saved route: Nb,Ub authoritative; rN=Nb-Nhat, rE=Ub-Uhat retained, never repaired or clipped; Tb=Ub/(c*Nb). Initial EOS mismatch is separately reported when a saved Ua is supplied.
Tb-That=(rE*Nhat-Uhat*rN)/(c*Nhat*(Nhat+rN)); conditional absolute bound with supplied eN<Nhat and eE.
Exact endpoint JVP and logT JVP, with all count, energy, c, volume and normalization directions explicit.
Positive independent U,N intervals map to [Ulo/(c*Nhi),Uhi/(c*Nlo)]; this is an enclosure without independence and sharp only for the full Cartesian box.
Two segment composition: convert second local-V1 increments with R1 before adding to the first V0 ledger.

General differentiable caloric EOS has unique bracketed endpoint if strictly increasing with positive derivative lower bound; inverse error and JVP follow. No unspecified general EOS solver is implemented.
